thread:
Alex P: quick sync — planning to flip the new client-side compat toggle for structured output in canary tomorrow morning. Wanted to call out scope and rollback steps.
Maria G: 👍 what's the canary audience again? and which SDK versions will read the toggle?
Alex P: canary = 5% orgs (prod-only) + all internal staging orgs. SDKs: js@>=2.4.0 & python@>=1.9.3 will respect the `structured_output` compat flag. older clients will ignore it.
Sam K: note: mobile SDKs (iOS/Android) don't ship support yet, they will fall back to opaque text. we should block mobile orgs from the canary.
Jordan L: added a quick filter on rollout config: `exclude_tags: ["mobile-client"]` — PR: github.com/redwood/infra/pull/812
Tina R: QA checklist: record telemetry for `compat.structured_output` impression + log fallback path. qa-bot please run smoke after flip.
qa-bot: queued smoke tests for 2024-11-14T16:00Z, will post results in thread.
Sam K: danger case to watch: old SDKs might now attempt function calling when a model emits `tools` metadata. we added server-side guard: if client version < min_support, rewrite to `structured_output=false` on the response path. see middleware snippet:
```
if client_version < MIN_STRUCTURED_VER:
  response.flags.structured_output = False
```
Maria G: nice. can we also add log metric `structured_output_blocked_by_client` with labels `client_version` and `org_id`? want to quickly see if many clients are blocked.
Alex P: yep, metric added. Grafana: dashboards/infra/compat/structured-output (temp)
Jordan L: deployment plan: 1) enable flag in staging 2) smoke + perf 3) enable 5% prod canary (exclude mobile) 4) wait 48h, monitor metrics + errors 5) 25% 6) GA. rollback: flip flag off + revert canary routing. rollout bot will run rollback if error_rate > 0.5% sustained 15m.
Maria G: who's on-call for rollback window? I can cover first 12h of canary morning, then Alex takes over.
Alex P: thanks. I'll post the exact time for the flip (aiming 09:00 PT). Sam — can you ping mobile PM to confirm exclusion tag is accurate?
Sam K: pinged @mobile-pm in #product, they confirmed.
deploy-bot: scheduled toggle change: enable `compat.structured_output` for canary group at 1718400000 (job id 3344)
qa-bot: smoke passed in staging (basic generation, fncall simulation) — no increase in 500s.
Tina R: quick note for SDK: remember to document behavior when server rewrites `structured_output=false` (it's a hard fallback). add to changelog.
Alex P: thanks team — I'll follow up with the exact flip timestamp and watch links. If anyone sees odd parser errors after canary starts, drop logs here and tag me.
Maria G: LGTM. :thumbsup:
